program.title: BSc in Global China Studies
uncertain: total_required_credits (69.0) is a calculated value for the INTEGRATED HUMANITIES AND SOCIAL SCIENCE TRACK: 15 (common) + SHSS capstone (3-6, counted as 6 when SHSS 4992 chosen) + 6 (track required) + 18 (restricted electives) + 24 (HUMA/SOSC/SHSS electives) = 69. When capstone is SHSS 4991 (3 credits), the HUMA/SOSC/SHSS electives become 27, giving the same 69 total (3+27=6+24).

The Social Science Track is mutually exclusive with the Integrated Track. Its total is approximately 66-69: 15 (common) + SHSS capstone (3 or 6) + 15 (track required) + 6 (foundation electives) + 27 (SOSC electives). Because the two tracks are mutually exclusive, the sum of ALL groups listed below exceeds 69; only one track applies to a given student.

The six Research Options (Applied Economics, Environment and Technology, Heritage and Cultural Sustainability, Language and Literature, Politics, Sociology) are OPTIONAL and excluded from total_required_credits.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 GCS (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the 2026-27 intake curriculum.

groups.note: Students should follow ONE of the two tracks (Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track OR Social Science Track). This group belongs to the Integrated Track.

groups.name: Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track Restricted Electives
groups.note: HUMA/SOSC Restricted Electives: 6 courses (18 credits), which should include three 3000-level and three 4000-level courses taken from at least 3 different areas. Areas: Environment, Economy & Globalization; Heritage, Community & Identity; Political & Social Change; Literature, Communication & Media. This group belongs to the Integrated Track. Remarks: SOSC 4290 last offered 2023-24 and deleted; kept as printed.

groups.name: Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track HUMA/SOSC/SHSS Electives
groups.note: HUMA/SOSC/SHSS Electives: students opting for SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) take min 8 courses (24 credits), 2 at 3000-/4000-level; students opting for SHSS 4991 take min 9 courses (27 credits), 3 at 3000-/4000-level. This is an open-ended elective (any HUMA/SOSC/SHSS courses); the PDF provides no fixed course list, so courses array is empty. Combined with the capstone, the Integrated Track flexible-elective portion always equals 30 credits (6+24 or 3+27). This group belongs to the Integrated Track.

groups.note: SOSC Disciplinary Foundation Electives: 2 courses from the specified elective list, of which the courses should be taken from different areas (Introductory Demography: SOSC 1780, SOSC 1860; Introductory Psychology: SOSC 1960, SOSC 1980). This group belongs to the Social Science Track.
